info.title: LsMsgPack TypeScript generator
info.description: Writes TypeScript classes for the .NET model classes a server sends and receives with LsMsgPack's web formatters (with the values their constructors set), and the schemas the server will write, for the TypeScript client of application/x-lsmsgpack (@lsmsgpack/client) to hold before its first request.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: lsmsgpack-ts: TypeScript models and schemas for @lsmsgpack/client, from the compiled .NET classes.

options.name: --root
options.description: A type the server responds with (e.g. Shop.Invoice[], List<Shop.Invoice>), repeatable.

options.name: --request
options.description:
A type the server reads (a request body): a model, no schema. Repeatable.
[LtMsgPackSerializable(typeof(T))] in the assemblies are roots as well.

options.name: --solution
options.description:
Finds the roots as LsMsgPack's analyzers do: the results and parameters of controller actions,
the types handed to the serializers. Build it first: the types are taken from the assemblies.

options.name: --all-types
options.description: Every public class, struct and enum of the assemblies (models only).
